snippet.title: Tour De France 2012 - PS3 - [Saint-Jean-De-Maurienne-Annonay Davezieux] - Stage 13 - Flat finish ?
snippet.description:
After 2 days in the Mountain , it was suppose to be a "Rest Day" but Cunego, Evans, Voeckler would not rest ? - 

They Attack all over the place the last 10 KMS - But Maybe this would be Shlecks brothers advantage ? .. And Franck take time of the 3-4 riders in front of him in the overall Classement ? Could this be possible to get both Brothers on Podium ?
